overall_notes: This paper is a survey (The Why and The How: A Survey on Natural Language Interaction in Visualization) that categorizes 119 existing works on natural language interaction in visualization. It discusses NLG tasks and methods as part of the surveyed literature but does not conduct any NLG evaluations itself. The original extraction incorrectly treated this as a primary research paper that evaluates NLG tasks.
